description: The prompts for the result that was ordered by the judiciary

judicialResultPromptTypeId.description: The result prompt type from reference data.  Required for rollup and Nows purposes

label.description: The result prompt label provided from reference data during the resulting process

courtExtract.description: Indicates if the result prompt can be entered into a court extract

welshLabel.description: The corresponding welsh language result prompt label provided from reference data during the resulting process

value.description: The result prompt value provided by the judiciary and recorded by the person executing the resulting process

welshValue.description: The result prompt welsh value provided by the judiciary and recorded by the person executing the resulting process

type.description: The result prompt type provided by the judiciary and recorded by the person executing the resulting process

qualifier.description: Further qualifies the meaning of the result prompt

durationSequence.description: Determines if the prompt is describing the primary, secondary or tertiary duration in the duration element

promptSequence.description: The prompt sequence for sequencing purposes

promptReference.description: A static reference used for algorithmic processing of the result prompt

totalPenaltyPoints.description: Provides the number of penalty points when a prompt specifies driving endorsements

isFinancialImposition.description: Indicates that the prompt value is a sterling amount

usergroups.description: The user groups that are not authorised to view the result prompt

durationElement.description: structured representation of the prompt value

isDurationStartDate.description: Identifies if value represents a start date of the duration

isDurationEndDate.description: Identifies if value represents an end date of the duration

activeOrderExtended.description: Identifies if active order is extended

activeOrderNotExtended.description: Identifies if active order is not extended
